mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Knocked Airborne</titleLeft><mainText>This unit has been knocked airborne by Vel'Koz.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

mLocKeys.keySummary: Reactivate to split the missile at a 90 degree angle.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Reactivate to split the missile at a 90 degree angle.

mLocKeys.keySummary: Vel'Koz causes an area to explode, knocking up enemies, and knocking close enemies slightly away.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Vel'Koz disrupts a nearby area, causing it to explode, <status>Knocking Up</status> for @StunDuration@ seconds and dealing <magicDamage>@TotalDamage@ magic damage</magicDamage>. Enemies close to Vel'Koz will be <status>Knocked Back</status> instead of <status>Knocked Up</status>.

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Organic Deconstruction</titleLeft><mainText>Vel'Koz's abilities apply <font color='#FFFFFF'>Organic Deconstruction</font> to enemies on hit for @f3@ seconds. Basic Attacks will refresh Deconstruction, but will not add stacks. The third hit on an enemy <font color='#FFFFFF'>Deconstructs</font> it, dealing <font color='#FFFFFF'>@f1@</font> <font color='#99FF99'>(+@f2@)</font> True Damage.</mainText>

mLocKeys.keySummary: Vel'Koz's abilities apply <keywordName>Organic Deconstruction</keywordName> to enemies on hit. If 3 stacks are accumulated, the enemy will take a burst of true damage.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Vel'Koz's Abilities apply a stack of Deconstruction for @Duration@ seconds. Enemies with 3 stacks consume them and take @TotalDamage@ true damage.

Vel'Koz's Attacks refresh the duration of Deconstruction, but won't add new stacks.

mLocKeys.keySummary: Vel'Koz shoots a bolt of plasma that splits in two on reactivation or upon hitting an enemy. The bolt slows and damages on hit.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Vel'Koz shoots a plasma bolt that deals @TotalDamage@ magic damage and Slows by @SlowAmount*100@% decaying over @SlowDuration@ second(s). At the end of its range, on hitting a target, or on Recasting, the bolt splits and fires two new bolts at a 90 degree angle.

Killing a unit with this restores @TooltipManaRefund@ Mana.

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Life Form Disintegration Ray</titleLeft><mainText>Vel'Koz is busy disintegrating some lifeforms.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

mLocKeys.keySummary: Vel'Koz unleashes a channelled beam that follows the cursor for 2.5 seconds that deals magic damage. Organic Deconstruction Researches enemy champions causing them to take true damage instead.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Vel'Koz channels a ray of energy that follows the cursor, dealing a total of @TotalDamage@ magic damage over 2.5 seconds and Slowing by @Effect3Amount@%. Deals true damage instead to enemies recently damaged by {{Spell_VelkozPassive_Name}}.

Enemies gain stacks of Deconstruction periodically while in the beam.

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Researched</titleLeft><mainText>Vel'Koz has Researched you! Life Form Disintegration Ray will deal True Damage instead of Magic to you, because Science.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

mLocKeys.keySummary: Vel'Koz opens a rift to the void that deals an initial burst of damage, then explodes for a second burst of damage after a delay.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Vel'Koz opens a rift to the void, dealing @InitialDamage@ magic damage. The rift then erupts, dealing @SecondaryDamage@ magic damage.

This Ability has 2 charges (@AmmoRechargeTime@ second refresh).
